name: Men Treading China Clay in Pits
summary: This painting is from a set of 24 depicting the porcelain industry in China. It shows men treading china clay in pits and adding water. Europe could not produce true porcelain before the 18th century. Artists targeted paintings such this at Europeans eager to find out the secrets of porcelain manufa
